summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests PYX-201, an antibody-drug conjugate, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have returned or spread. How it is given, and how often or for how long, is not stated. The study measures the recommended dose(s) of PYX-201 and the objective response rate (ORR) when used alone.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa PYX-201, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que han regresado o se han diseminado. No se indica cómo se administra ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio mide la(s) dosis recomendada(s) de PYX-201 y la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR) cuando se usa como único agente.
who_for: Confirmed solid tumor, including certain breast, triple-negative breast, head and neck, or other tumor types with prior treatment line limits.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
Life expectancy over 3 months in the investigator's opinion.
not_for: Significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months before starting study drug.
Known active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV or AIDS.
Grade above 1 neuropathy of any cause.
Prior solid organ or bone marrow transplant.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
